description: This file defines the 'XFontMetrics' class, which collects and encapsulates font metric information such as ascent, descent, line spacing, and other font measurements, used within the PDFsharp library for font rendering.

classes.name: XFontMetrics
classes.description: A sealed class that holds various font metrics such as ascent, descent, line spacing, cap height, x height, and other measurements important for font rendering.

methods.description: Constructor initializing all font metric properties with specified values.
